description:
Port-map §3. Four tools registered on the Session, each wrapping
a pure file-operation and using FileMutex (.3) for writes/edits.

Modules under apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/tools/:
- read.ex — offset/limit, image detection (MIME), truncation
  (10k lines / 512 KB), returns %OctoPi.Agent.Tool.Result with
  details (totalLines, outputLines, truncatedBy)
- write.ex — creates parent dirs, fails if content changed since
  last read (compare-and-set pattern from upstream)
- edit.ex — diff-based edit (old_string, new_string, replace_all);
  wraps in FileMutex.with_lock
- ls.ex — non-recursive directory listing with basic metadata

All four implement OctoPi.Agent.Tool.Handler. Each returns
Tool.Result with is_error?: true for permission/not-found/etc.

Path resolution: relative paths resolved against session cwd (need
a way to thread cwd to the handler — likely via prepare_arguments
closure or session state injection).

TDD (match upstream test coverage):
- read: offset, limit, truncation, permission-denied, image
- write: new file, overwrite, intermediate-dir creation, missing
  permission
- edit: old_string not found, not unique, replace_all, whitespace
  preservation
- ls: empty dir, dir with subdirs, stat metadata

Depends on .3.
title: Core file tools: read, write, edit, ls
